::: {.obsidian-budget-proposal}
:::

State the proposal in one paragraph. Name the total, the period, and
the strategic goal it serves.

# Strategic context

State how the budget supports the organisation plan. Link the spend
to a named objective.

# Cost breakdown

Break the budget into categories. Use a table with category, amount,
and justification columns.

# Assumptions

State the assumptions behind the figures. Name the cost drivers and
the sensitivities.

# Risks

State the risks to the budget and the mitigation for each.

# Approval

State the decision required and the date by which it is needed.
